entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集核心论点：大公司里的智能体很聪明、有工具，但缺乏部落知识，每次新会话都像入职第一天的新员工，大多数任务从零开始。

evidence.quote: If your agent is in charge of HR practices or optimizing your kernels in your code base or resolving customer issues, that they would care about different things.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It basically abstracts with simple functions all the access to that information so that the agent that I'll tell you in a second doesn't have to know how to access the internal parts of the context.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If you're an agent, it's really important for you to give us the budget in tokens or in dollars, how much time you want us to invest in this.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And of course, what you get back is something that's agent friendly.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You will see at the top a question that the agent issued, and you see on the left the different steps that it went through.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: What Nexus does, which is very different than other systems, it's what we call a runtime coding agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And then on the right is the same task given to an agent with all the tooling to complete the task.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 知识层 (knowledge layer)
entities.how_described: 本集提出的智能体真正需要的新东西：持久、高度专业化、始终保持最新的公司知识承载层，本质上不同于 RAG 等其他数据源。

evidence.quote: I want to tell you a little bit about the new knowledge layer, and I'll start with telling you a little bit about theory of mind.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So I would argue that what they need is not necessarily to be smarter, to have better tools, but to have something new, which I would call a knowledge layer going forward.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I have to explain to you what I think a knowledge layer has to actually do.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The second thing is that you would argue that this knowledge layer needs to be highly specialized.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I will argue before we move on that I'm not suggesting that this knowledge layer should replace everything else we're doing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Nexus is a product that we're, of course, it's a knowledge layer, but I want to explain to you what it does.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So the context, think about that as the sum of assets that the Nexus or this knowledge layer saves about a specific topic.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In a knowledge layer, you don't do that anymore.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You tell the knowledge layer, you tell Nexus what you care about in a manifest.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And it's the knowledge layer's work to keep track of those files and organize its own data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 部落知识 (tribal knowledge)
entities.how_described: 本集定义为公司内部的通用知识——怎么做事、流程是什么、谁负责什么、指导原则是什么——资深员工有而新员工没有，没法靠一次搜索捞出来。

evidence.quote: And then I would say there is tribal knowledge.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Tribal knowledge is the general knowledge inside the company.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Even though 9,000 documents going from a day before yesterday to the last 10 years say it's somebody else, this has become common tribal knowledge immediately.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: RAG
entities.how_described: 本集说 RAG 和搜索等工具早就基本解决了公司特定知识的检索问题，但它拿不到部落知识——换 CEO 后 RAG 搜索仍会告诉你旧答案。

evidence.quote: And RAG and Search and, of course, Pinecone, VectalDBs, and so on, solved these problems a long time ago.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And everything else, even every RAG search will tell you otherwise, this is now the overriding fact.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Search, of course, like RAG, Vectal Search, Text Search, and so on.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Manifest（清单） (manifest)
entities.how_described: 本集称之为知识层里第一个真正新颖的想法：你只需在 manifest 里声明要完成的任务、追踪的实体、关心的信息，文件追踪和数据组织全交给知识层，可理解为元知识文件。

evidence.quote: But then it has the manifest.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The manifest is the first truly novel idea in an important entity.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You tell the knowledge layer, you tell Nexus what you care about in a manifest.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So think about the manifest as the meta knowledge file or set of files.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It's all maintained through the manifest.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It takes the manifest, which tells, okay, now what things do I care about?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: NoQL
entities.how_described: 本集称之为系统第二有意思的部分：指定如何从上下文取数的方式，智能体可以用 token 或美元给出预算，返回智能体友好的有依据文本加结构化格式。

evidence.quote: Which is NoQL.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: NoQL is our way to specify how we want information out of the context.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 运行时编码智能体 (runtime coding agent)
entities.how_described: 本集说 Nexus 与其他系统最大的不同：查询时引擎现场搭建类似 Jupyter Notebook 的环境，写代码、执行、按需重写，答案由代码产出而非查数据库，提示词从约 15 万 token 降到不足 1 千。

evidence.quote: What Nexus does, which is very different than other systems, it's what we call a runtime coding agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 心智理论 (theory of mind)
entities.how_described: 开场用心理学这个概念点题：我们理解他人知道什么、相信什么、会怎么行动的能力——人们对产品知道什么往往判断很差，如今对智能体也在犯同样的错。

evidence.quote: But this is a funny way to say, yeah, people have a very bad theory of mind on sort of what the products that they use, what information they have and what they don't have.

entities.how_described: 本集顺带提到：Pinecone、向量数据库等工具和 RAG、搜索一起，早就解决了公司特定知识的检索问题。

entities.how_described: 本集提到 Karpathy 提出的这个想法——让智能体管理一批 markdown 文件给自己记笔记——与知识层存 markdown 的做法类似，算是加强版。

evidence.quote: Who here has heard about LLMWiki?

evidence.quote: Okay, so LLMWiki is this idea that Andrei Karpathy suggested to have agents basically manage some stash of markdown files to sort of keep their own notes of stuff.
